translation.name: Kazuwamgbani ka savu n Tsikimba n aɓon a ɗa a ɗanga̱sai a kazuwamgbani ka cau

content: Katsumate ka zuba n maku ma tagara̱da

Aku n wenei kpam kuwene, katsumate ka zuba ka ucira ka̱ri ucipa̱ a iyamba. U wambanai kalishi yavu kunya, n kasomini zuba n kaci ka ne. Upetiwaꞌeshi u ne wa laɗa yavu kaara, aꞌene a ne kpam yavu adawatsu a akina.
Wa ɓa̱na̱ maku ma tagara̱da ma ma̱ri uba̱ra̱kpi. U shamgbai n kune ku ulyaki ku ne a kushiva̱, ka ugula̱ kpam a kagiɗa.
U wura̱ngi yavu gabako. An u wura̱ngi, aku mkpankashila̱ n shindere n wushuki.
An mkpankashila̱ mi n wushuki, mpa na̱ n cigi n gita̱ ikorongi, aku n panai kala̱ga̱tsu a zuba ka danai, “Sokongu ili iꞌya mkpankashila̱ n shindere mi n danai vi, kotsu vu korongu iꞌya wa.”
Katsumate ka zuba ki ka ra̱ɗa̱gba̱i kukere ku ulyaki ku ne ubana a zuba.

Aku u tsinai n kala ka Kashila̱, ka ka̱ri n uma hal ubana bawu utyoku, uza ɗa u yain zuba n ili iꞌya iꞌa̱ri a asuvu a le, n iyamba n ili iꞌya iꞌa̱ri a asuvu a le, n kushiva̱ n ili iꞌya iꞌa̱ri a asuvu a le gba̱, ukuna u maci u ɗa wa tono. U da, “Kashila̱ ka ɓa̱ra̱kpa̱ wa, aku u yain ili iꞌya u foɓusoi.
Shegai katsumate ka zuba ka shindere ki ka fula̱ baci kavana ka ne, Kashila̱ ka yan ta̱ ili iꞌya wa̱ri u sokongi hal utuwa̱ gogo‑na vi, tyoku ɗa u tonukoi agbashi a ne, ntsumate.”
Kala̱ga̱tsu ka doki ka isa̱ mu: “Wala vu ba vu wushi tagara̱da u ɗa wa̱ri uba̱ra̱kpi vi, u ɗa katsumate ka zuba ka ɓa̱na̱ vi.”

Aku n banai a asu u katsumate ka zuba ki, n tonuko yi u na̱ka̱ mu maku ma tagara̱da mi. Aku u tonuko mu, “Wusha tagara̱da vi vu takuma u ɗa. Wa yankpa ta̱ a una̱ u vunu yavu ishigi, shegai wa vura̱ vu ta̱ katsuma̱.”
N wushai tagara̱da u ɗa wa ɓa̱na̱ vi n takumai. U yankpa ta̱ cika yavu ishigi a una̱ u va̱, shegai an n soɗugi u ɗa, aku u vura̱ mu katsuma̱.
A tonuko mu kpam, “U ka̱na̱ ta̱ vu doku vu tonuko ama ili iꞌya Kashila̱ ka foɓusoi u yanka ama n iyamba n aletsu kau‑kau, na̱ ngono gba̱.”
